note: Rifle optic entries. Every value comes from the rifle optic table of the AEE sensor device library, a tier-5 compilation, so every value is grade claimed. The SpecterDR's US service designation is the SU-230/PVS (wikipedia_elcan_specter), so the 1-4x class answers to it; the SU-230A is the 7.62 mm variant of the same sight.
